description: This PHP source file defines the RegistrationAPIClientService class, which provides methods for creating an HTTP client and publishing data to a registration API endpoint, with integrated logging and error handling.

classes.name: RegistrationAPIClientService
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with a registration API via HTTP, including client setup and data publishing with error handling.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Guzzle HTTP client configured with the API base URI.

methods.name: publishData
methods.description: Sends data to the registration API endpoint using a POST request and returns true if successful, false otherwise, with error logging.
